content_of_post_to_comment:
not the generic "just start small" advice — the specific thing that broke through when you were genuinely stuck, past the point where willpower alone was cutting it.

for me it was telling one friend a specific date I'd show them progress. Something about a real person expecting it snapped me out of a weeks-long stall in a way self-imposed deadlines never did.

what was it for you, and what were you stuck on at the time?
